svg.text: CPU ms of a Hive restart's app.New (the daemon's 'building the modules') on a 300 MB journal (value, lower is better)

circle.title: #1 yes: 6662.0 - journal: parse the fixed envelope Append writes ({seq,at,kind,data}) directly in Replay/Since/OpenJournal, data left raw for Decode; json.Unmarshal for any other line (42092/42092 lines fast, identical to Unmarshal)

#2 yes: 5110.0 - journal read in place (ReadSlice, 1 MB buffer, copy only an event's data) + ReplayExcept: the 12 replays that never read task.saved/run.created (92% of the bytes) pass over them uncopied; kb's replay decodes only kb.filing/kb.filed

#3 yes: 3660.0 - kb recorder on a replay: a snapshot filed before this start is kept as raw data under its subject (read from 5 top-level fields with jsontext, the rest skipped) and decoded only if a later one diffs against it; past non-snapshots return before any decode
#4 no: 4099.0 - ReplayExcept for the four replays that read one of the two bulk kinds but not the other: improve, work, feedback pass over run.created; runs passes over task.saved
#5 no: 3270.0 - improve's replay decodes each task.saved once and hands it to applyStall, applyQuarantine and its own switch, which each decoded it again

#6 no: 3294.0 - bundle of tries 4 and 5 (+12%, +11% alone, each under the 26% margin): improve, work, feedback pass over run.created and runs over task.saved; improve decodes a task.saved once for its three appliers
